description.value:
Duration constant

You hold more of a fight in your body than most people can carry out of one.

Your Tally cap increases by 1. This stacks with the increases your level already grants. Tally above your old cap behaves exactly like any other Tally — it does not drain faster and it is not lost between fights.

cinderfall.incomplete: Raises the caster's Tally cap by 1. Deadhand's Tally is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
